description: SAPOS, the satellite positioning service of the German state survey administrations, is a joint project of the AdV that provides the official geodetic reference frame through a Germany-wide network of about 270 permanently operated GNSS reference stations, plus reference stations in neighbouring countries. It delivers uniform, high-accuracy correction data services in the official three-dimensional reference system ETRS89/DREF91 for the whole country. Each federal state runs its own SAPOS operator, listed on the page with links, and a central office at the Lower Saxony survey agency (LGLN) in Hannover serves customers who need cross-state or nationwide use. Access is arranged through the state operator; terms, fees and licence are set by each state, and no licence is stated on the page read. Caveats: the page is in German, services and prices differ by state, and the station data is a correction service, not an open archive. Coverage is Germany. It supports positioning infrastructure studies, for example GNSS dependence of surveying, construction and transport, and the monitoring of space weather effects on positioning; the related record is the OS Net network of Great Britain.
